2.t: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––

3.t: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,

4.t: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.

5.t: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.

6.t: The disbelievers think it is distant,

7.t: but We know it to be close.

8.t: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass

9.t: and the mountains like tufts of wool,

10.t: when no friend will ask about his friend,

11.t: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,

13.t: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,

14.t: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.

15.t: But no! There is a raging flame

17.t: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,

20.t: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,

21.t: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.

23.t: and are constant in their prayers;

24.t: who give a due share of their wealth

26.t: who believe in the Day of Judgement

27.t: and fear the punishment of their Lord––

28.t: none may feel wholly secure from it––

30.t: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,

31.t: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––

32.t: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;

34.t: and are steadfast in their prayers.

35.t: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.

36.t: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],

37.t: from right and left, in crowds?

38.t: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?

39.t: No! We created them from the substance they know,

40.t: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power

41.t: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.

42.t: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,

43.t: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,

44.t: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
